Can Redwood provide the attestation template filled out, and also confirm whether you can accept a split PO (initial partial prepay + remainder on delivery)? We have an internal approval window that closes Friday 11/19 EOD PT — can we fast-path this?

Jonas — appreciate the turnaround. A couple quick clarifications from our procurement/finance side: 

1) The split PO shape you suggested (40/60) is acceptable as long as Redwood can start provisioning the uplift on receiving the initial PO and confirmation of payment. We need clear acceptance evidence for our controller.
2) On the SLA amendment: can Redwood accept a 99.5% availability SLA for the uplifted capacity tier? If not, what alternatives do you propose (credits, failover behavior)?

We'd like to avoid legal back-and-forth if possible — if your legal redline is straightforward we can accept via DocuSign the same day.

Hi Tom / Maya — looping in the legal and billing perspective. Short answers: 

- Availability: Redwood can provision a targeted 99.5% SLA for the dedicated uplift lane, contingent on a documented fallover plan (we'll add failover to a compatible model variant across regions). For any sustained <99.5% breaches, standard service credits apply (we will include the formula in the amendment).

- Split PO / prepay: Ben can accept a 40% prepayment applied to committed capacity; remainder invoiced net 30. We will need the PO to reference deal RDW-2027-0098 and include Velera's billing account number.

- Attestation: Thanks for the intake doc. We completed the attestation and attached it; please verify the technical contacts in section 3.

I'm attaching SLA amendment v1 with the availability clause and credit formula highlighted. If Velera confirms, we can DocuSign today and Ben will send the payment instructions.

Best,
